posts.author: Nova Sterling
posts.text: Woke up at 5, ran 6 km, and remembered that the hardest part is always the doorway. Whatever your doorway is today — walk through it.

posts.author: Ira Volt
posts.text: Finished a painting I hated for three weeks. Turns out it just needed a storm in the corner.

posts.author: Milo Grey
posts.text: Learned that a group of pugs is called a grumble. My entire personality is now a grumble.

posts.author: Sana Aether
posts.text: Reminder from someone who learned it the slow way: love that requires you to shrink is just admiration with rent.

posts.author: Theo Kane
posts.text: Made this for the days when the plan collapses.

posts.author: Juno Pike
posts.text: I let myself write badly for 20 minutes a day. Eleven months later there is a novel on my desk. Bad writing compounds into books.

posts.author: Ren Okada
posts.text: My productivity system is fear, coffee, and a playlist called 'do the thing'. It is undefeated.

posts.author: Ada Lumen
posts.text: Read that couples who laugh together during arguments recover faster afterwards. So we now argue in silly voices. Highly effective, deeply stupid.

posts.author: Kai Brenner
posts.text: Storm fact I think about daily: lightning does not go down, it meets something reaching up. Be the thing reaching up.

posts.author: Lena Faro
posts.text: A collage from my sketchbook margins.

posts.author: Osric Vale
posts.text: My plant died. I have decided it moved out for creative reasons and we are still on good terms.

posts.author: Mira Halden
posts.text: For long distance people. We are on the same current.

posts.author: Dorian Ash
posts.text: Day 400 of showing up. Nothing dramatic happened today, and that is the whole secret.

posts.author: Yara Nix
posts.text: Fun one: the inventor of the Pringles can was buried in one. Commit to your work, I guess.

posts.author: Peregrine Volt
posts.text: Honeybees can recognise human faces. Somewhere out there a bee remembers me screaming.

posts.author: Selene Cordis
posts.text: Told my grandmother I was scared of loving again. She said hearts are muscles, not glass. Then she gave me soup.
